title: Training sandboxes for data scientists (DSW, not an agent sandbox)
reference: PAI-DSW workspaces for each data scientist with OSS and NAS (or CPFS) mounts, PAI-DLC for bigger fine-tuning jobs, a VPC with NAT for package installs and a RAM role instead of keys, in Singapore. No agent sandbox (ACS Agent Sandbox, Agent Sandbox, AgentBay or PAI-Instant), and no single PAI box.

turns.ask: Our 12 data scientists need sandbox environments with GPUs where they can experiment with and fine-tune models on our datasets. We are in Singapore.

title: Agent hosting with ACS sandboxes
reference: Users reach an agent API on ACS (behind an ALB); the ACS cluster claims sandboxes from ACS Agent Sandbox (Container edition, generally available) for the generated code, drawn inside the VPC with an edge from the ACS node; the agent calls Qwen through AI Gateway and Model Studio (or a PAI-EAS model); sandbox egress is allowlisted through NAT; credentials through Agent Identity or KMS. Says the sandbox has CPU and memory only, no GPU. No PAI-Instant Service, and no preview wording.

turns.ask: A client wants to host AI agents for their own customers. Each agent writes and runs Python code, which must execute in isolated sandboxes on ACS. The agents use Qwen models.

title: Post-training on PAI, then serving on PAI-EAS
reference: Training data in OSS; SFT through PAI Model Gallery or a PAI-DLC job; checkpoints back to OSS; a deploy edge to PAI-EAS (vLLM) serving a private endpoint, ideally behind AI Gateway. Separate stage nodes, not one PAI box. No LangStudio.

turns.ask: We want to fine-tune Qwen3-8B on our support tickets with SFT and then serve it privately for our internal apps. Use PAI.

title: RAG on PAI-EAS with a self-hosted LLM
reference: An ALB in front of a PAI-EAS RAG service and a separate PAI-EAS LLM service (decoupled mode); vector store Elasticsearch, Hologres or RDS PostgreSQL in the same VPC; knowledge files in OSS. No Milvus in the template, no FAISS in production, no Model Studio knowledge base and no LangStudio.

turns.ask: Build a RAG chatbot over our product manuals using the PAI-EAS RAG deployment with our own self-hosted LLM, in Singapore.

title: RAG on Model Studio APIs without GPUs
reference: Compute (Function Compute, SAE, ACS or AgentRun) calls Model Studio for embedding, rerank and generation, retrieves from Milvus or OpenSearch, keeps documents in OSS and has an ingestion step; AI Gateway and AI Guardrails are good additions; NAT egress from VPC compute because Singapore has no documented Model Studio private endpoint. No Model Studio knowledge base and no self-hosted model.

turns.ask: We want a RAG assistant over our help-center articles that uses Qwen through Model Studio. We don't want to manage GPUs or host models ourselves.

title: Training data stays in Singapore; evaluation added later
reference: Turn 1 pins Singapore and draws PAI-DLC or Model Gallery training with OSS and PAI-EAS serving, all in Singapore. Turn 2 adds tracing and evaluation with in-region SLS or ARMS (or Model Studio as a judge), not AgentLoop, which runs only in Hong Kong internationally; if it mentions AgentLoop it says why it is left out.

turns.ask: Our training data must stay in Singapore. We want to post-train an open Qwen model on PAI and serve it to our app.
Add tracing and quality evaluation for the model's answers.

title: Agent hosting with ACS sandboxes (Korean)
reference: Same as the English case: ACS with ACS Agent Sandbox inside the VPC and an edge from the ACS node, AI Gateway and Model Studio (or PAI-EAS), allowlisted egress, the no-GPU caveat. Say and why text in Korean; product names as in the catalog.

turns.ask: 고객사가 자사 고객을 위한 AI 에이전트를 호스팅하려고 합니다. 에이전트가 생성한 파이썬 코드는 ACS의 격리된 샌드박스에서 실행되어야 하고, 모델은 Qwen을 사용합니다. 아키텍처를 그려 주세요.

title: Fine-tune Qwen on 8 GPUs next week for a PoC (PAI-DLC, Lingjun not a prerequisite)
reference: PAI-DLC on public GPUs with data and checkpoints in OSS (and optionally PAI-EAS to try the result). Lingjun is not drawn and not described as required: it is allowlisted through the account manager with no published lead time, which does not fit a PoC next week. No GPU model named other than A10, T4, V100 or P100, with newer cards flagged for sales confirmation.

turns.ask: We want to fine-tune Qwen on 8 GPUs next week for a PoC. We are in Singapore.

title: Agentic RL rollouts with no Kubernetes (Agent Sandbox Flash edition, no official reference)
reference: A PAI-DLC trainer on public GPUs calling Agent Sandbox (Flash edition, E2B-compatible API) for the rollouts, checkpoints and trajectories in OSS, the final policy on PAI-EAS. No ACS, ACK or ACS Agent Sandbox because the customer has no Kubernetes. The narration states this is a custom design with no official reference and points to the documented ACK plus VeRL walkthrough. No PAI-Instant (China-only).

turns.ask: Our RL training runs on PAI-DLC GPUs. Every rollout executes code the model wrote, so thousands of sandboxes must run at once. We are in Singapore and have no Kubernetes.
